sample_choice.rule: recent unions ship unless their counts and margins cannot support a stable fit (IPF converged, face validity, every edu cell and every own-group race cell >= 100 effective sides, no metro below 100 Kish sides); then the time-weighted sample with the smallest out-of-sample Pew error. The stock is never shipped (a 1985 marriage voting as loudly as a 2024 one).
sample_choice.pew_confound: Pew's newlyweds are 2011-2015 unions; samples that weight older unions more move toward Pew's period as well as toward its pattern, so the Pew criterion cannot separate 'fits current pairing better' from 'sits closer to the test period'
